title: Phantom Blade Zero Collector's Edition - ¥1,199 Box, No Disc
description: There are two different things called a collector's edition for Phantom Blade Zero. The China box is real, limited to 20,000 sets at ¥1,199, and contains a WeGame code rather than a disc. A global PS5 Ultimate steelbook edition was announced in the launch trailer for 2027.

sections.title: Two Products, One Name
sections.content:
Searches for a Phantom Blade Zero collector's edition are pulling up two different things, and they are not interchangeable:

  • The China collector's box - announced 13 August 2026, ¥1,199, sold only through JD.com, limited to 20,000 sets worldwide. It is a figures-and-memorabilia package with a PC download code in it. There is no game disc.
  • The global PS5 Ultimate edition - announced during the launch trailer on 21-22 October 2026 alongside standard and Deluxe boxed editions, expected in 2027, in a collector's steelbook. No contents, price, date or region list has been published.

The reason this distinction matters commercially: for most of October, the honest answer to "is there a physical Phantom Blade Zero?" was no. Retailers had listed boxed PS5 copies and pulled them, and Play-Asia told a customer by email that no physical edition was coming. The launch trailer reversed that for 2027, so anything published before 21 October - including a lot of what still ranks today - is now out of date on this specific point.

sections.title: The China Collector's Box: Everything S-GAME Published
sections.content:
Priced at ¥1,199 (roughly 180 US dollars at announcement) and capped at 20,000 sets worldwide, this is a JD.com exclusive through the game's own flagship store. No other channel, region or platform was given a listing. Purchases were limited to one set per buyer as an anti-resale measure, and reservations ran in two batches:

  • Batch 1 - reservations opened 10:00 on 14 August, purchase window 12:00 on 17 August, shipping promised before 29 October 2026
  • Batch 2 - reservations reopened 18:00 on 17 August, purchase window 12:00 on 19 August, shipping promised by 31 December 2026

Contents, as published by S-GAME:

  • 1/12 scale articulating figure of Soul, in clothed costume with two replaceable head sculpts, five sheathed weapons, five replaceable hand types and a display base
  • Flaming Lion Head necklace, metal pendant - described as gold-plated, and separately as white steel with gold plating, so read the finish as reported rather than settled
  • White Python Red Chain keychain, zinc alloy
  • Weapons compendium booklet (兵器谱) covering the game's arms
  • Ink-wash wanted-poster print and other printed material
  • WeGame digital Deluxe activation code, including the pre-order bonus

Physical specs given at announcement: net weight about 3 kg, outer box 32 × 12.5 × 47 cm, built from PVC, ABS, alloy and real fabric. The figure wears a straw hat and rain cape - the wanderer look from the game's marketing.

sections.title: The Game Inside Is a PC Code
sections.content:
This is the single most misunderstood thing about the box. The game copy is a WeGame activation code for the digital Deluxe edition - Tencent's PC storefront, for mainland accounts. It cannot be redeemed on PlayStation, and there is no disc in the package at any point.

So if you are buying for PS5, the collector's box buys you the figure, the jewellery, the booklets and nothing that plays the game: you would still purchase the digital Deluxe edition separately on the PlayStation Store. If you are on PC in China, the code covers the same content as the digital Deluxe - the two Deluxe outfits plus the art book and soundtrack, with the pre-order unlocks attached.

Two further conditions S-GAME attached:

  • The code is claimed through JD, not in the box. Once the game is available for download - no later than 29 October - buyers collect the activation code through the gift-order entry in their JD order.
  • Claiming the code ends your return rights. After the code is collected, the physical box is no longer returnable for a refund. If you are on the fence, claim it only when you have decided to keep the set.

Reservation numbers and a first-batch sell-out were reported by Chinese coverage rather than published by S-GAME, so treat "sold out" as press-reported. What is official is the 20,000-unit cap and the absence of any announced third batch.

sections.title: The 2027 PS5 Ultimate Edition
sections.content:
The launch trailer released 21-22 October 2026 announced PS5 physical standard, Deluxe and Ultimate collector's steelbook editions for 2027. That is the first time a boxed release for Western and Japanese territories has been confirmed, and it is what makes Play-Asia's earlier withdrawal a snapshot of a plan that has since changed.

What is not known, and should not be guessed:

  • Any date inside 2027, or a price in any currency
  • What the Ultimate edition contains beyond the steelbook case - no art book, statue or map has been announced for it
  • Whether the boxed disc is version 1.0 or needs the day-one patch, and therefore whether the reported 134.857 GB install still applies
  • Whether the China collector's box and the 2027 Ultimate edition are related products at all, or a figures package and a game release that happen to share a name

Anyone showing a photo of a steelbook or listing a pre-order price for it is beyond what has been published.

sections.title: Should You Buy One?
sections.content:
Roughly, by what you actually want:

  • You want to play on PS5 from a disc. Neither product does that today. Wait for the 2027 standard or Ultimate box and its contents list; the China box will never redeem on PlayStation.
  • You want the figure and the display piece. The China box is the only one that exists, it is JD-exclusive, and overseas buyers need a forwarding service - which adds real cost on top of ¥1,199 for a package whose software half you cannot use outside WeGame.
  • You are on PC in China and want the Deluxe content. The box is worth less than buying the digital Deluxe directly unless you want the physical goods; the software it unlocks is the same.
  • You are deciding today whether to pre-order at all. The review embargo is reported to lift 26 October - see the reviews page for how solid that date actually is - which leaves a short window where scored reviews exist but the Deluxe discount and pre-order bonuses may not.

Sources: S-GAME's official Weibo announcement of the collector's box (14 August 2026) as reproduced by IT之家 and 游侠网; the launch-trailer physical-edition announcement as reported by Gematsu on 22 October 2026. Numbers here are the publisher's own: price, unit cap, dates and box contents. Where a spec is only in one report, it is marked.
